blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Fans of Alex Eala have long been waiting to see their hero play in the Singapore Open. Eala, who arrived in the Lion City last week, won’t make her much-awaited main draw debut until Thursday, but the tennis sensation gave her fans a glimpse on Wednesday during a Q&A session at Kallang. Many of her supporters were already on site as early as 1:00 p.m., several hours before her scheduled Q&A, which was relocated inside the National Stadium.
